description:
We are seeking an experienced and dedicated Director of Nursing (DON) to lead the clinical team at a premier skilled nursing facility in Mediapolis, IA. This pivotal leadership role offers the opportunity to shape patient care standards, foster a supportive environment for nursing staff, and ensure the highest quality of service delivery. Join a facility committed to excellence and compassionate care for its residents.
As the DON, you will be instrumental in overseeing all aspects of nursing operations, including staff management, regulatory compliance, and the implementation of best practices. This role is ideal for a visionary leader passionate about making a significant impact on the lives of residents and empowering a team of dedicated healthcare professionals. We offer a competitive salary and a supportive work environment.
requirements: Active Registered Nurse (RN) license in Iowa
Minimum of 2-3 years of experience in a nursing leadership role, preferably as a Director of Nursing or Assistant Director of Nursing
Experience in a skilled nursing facility or long-term care setting
Strong knowledge of state and federal regulations governing skilled nursing facilities
Excellent leadership, communication, and organizational skills
salaryOrBonusInfo: Annual salary range of $85,000 - $95,000, commensurate with experience.

facilityType: a premier health and rehabilitation center
description:
We are seeking a dedicated and experienced Assistant Director of Nursing (ADON) to join a premier health and rehabilitation center in Olathe, KS. This is an excellent opportunity for a nursing leader to contribute to high-quality patient care and support a compassionate team.

In this vital role, you will assist the Director of Nursing in overseeing daily nursing operations, ensuring compliance with healthcare regulations, and fostering a positive environment for both staff and residents. We are looking for a candidate with a strong clinical background and a passion for leadership.

This position offers a competitive salary range of $75,000 - $85,000 per year. We highly prefer candidates who are Registered Nurses (RNs) to bring their expertise to our team.
requirements: Previous experience as an Assistant Director of Nursing or in a similar nursing leadership role
Experience in a skilled nursing or long-term care setting
Strong leadership, organizational, and communication skills

description: We are seeking a dedicated and experienced MDS Coordinator (RN) to join a premier skilled nursing facility in Missouri Valley, IA. This vital role involves overseeing the Resident Assessment Instrument (RAI) process, ensuring accurate and timely completion of MDS assessments, and contributing to comprehensive care planning for our residents. Your expertise will be instrumental in maintaining compliance and optimizing reimbursement while upholding the highest standards of patient care.This full-time position offers a competitive annual salary ranging from $65,000 to $75,000. We are looking for a professional who is passionate about making a difference in the lives of residents and thrives in a collaborative environment.If you are an RN with a strong background in MDS and a commitment to excellence, we encourage you to apply and become a key part of our compassionate care team.
requirements: Active and unrestricted Registered Nurse (RN) license in the state of Iowa.
Minimum of 1-2 years of experience as an MDS Coordinator in a skilled nursing facility.
Comprehensive knowledge of the Resident Assessment Instrument (RAI) process and Medicare/Medicaid regulations.
Proficiency in electronic health records (EHR) and MDS software.
salaryOrBonusInfo: Annual salary ranging from $65,000 to $75,000, based on experience.

description:
We are seeking a dedicated Full-time MDS Coordinator to join a leading skilled nursing facility in Des Moines, IA. This pivotal role is essential for ensuring accurate resident assessments, developing comprehensive care plans, and maintaining compliance with federal and state regulations. You will play a crucial part in the interdisciplinary team, contributing directly to the quality of care our residents receive.

As an MDS Coordinator, you will be responsible for completing and transmitting the Minimum Data Set (MDS) assessments, coordinating the care planning process, and ensuring all documentation accurately reflects the resident's condition and care needs. This full-time position offers a competitive hourly rate, reflecting your expertise and commitment to excellence.

If you are a detail-oriented professional with a passion for resident advocacy and regulatory compliance, we encourage you to apply. Join a team committed to providing exceptional care and fostering a supportive environment.
requirements: Proven experience as an MDS Coordinator in a skilled nursing facility
Strong understanding of MDS 3.0 and associated regulations
Excellent assessment, documentation, and communication skills
salaryOrBonusInfo: Hourly rate of $36.00 - $40.00, based on experience.
